reason: Machine lens: all opcodes NMOS/65SC12 (LDA #, STA abs, RTS); SKIP 5 replaces exactly LDY #4 (2) + DEY (1) + BNE (2), so .noise stays at &A5A4 and nothing in bank 5 moves; no branch, table read or page crossing changes; wait_low (BNE in-page) and the BRA sfx_write/ddra_set_c046b entries untouched; no self-modified operand in the region; wait_high referenced nowhere. Cycles: old tail after wait_low LDY#8 2 + STY 4 + LDY#4 2 + DEY/BNE x4 (4*2+3*3+2=19) + RTS 6 = 33; new LDA#8 2 + STA 4 + RTS 6 = 12; saves 21 (the following 1 MHz VIA access may shift its stretch by +/-1 since 21 is odd, a nominal-count caveat only). State at return: X, C, V kept; Y = 0 from wait_low's exit as before; A becomes &08 instead of the written byte and Z = 0 instead of 1: checked every return path - sfx_output's callers reload A (LDA sfx_p_hi, LDA sfx_v, BRA amplitude -> LDA sfx_v), sfx_next_ramp.ended returns to DEX (sfx_t_req_next, .next, sfx_silence's loop), sfx_tick returns to PLA/STA romsel in irq1_handler, sfx_silence returns to LDA #&FF and to CLI/JMP in bank 5; none reads A or Z/N. Hardware: SN76489 write-enable-low hold (wait_low, 17 cycles) unchanged; the next chip write starts >= ~31 cycles after the rise on every path, beyond the 8us the trailing delay provided.
